Close only with documented rank agreement or an accepted definitional mismatch.

Dashboard, briefs, and README figures are incremental KPI, not currency and not client revenue, and are easy to misread as ROI dollars. Kept open so Sprint 3+ copy and UI keep the disclaimer visible until product language deliberately changes. Applies across STORY-301, STORY-302, STORY-401, and STORY-402.

nodes.label: STORY-501 Exogenous Control Variables and Organic Traffic ETL
nodes.norm_label: story-501 exogenous control variables and organic traffic etl
nodes.rationale: Media alone is not the whole world. Holidays, paydays, organic search, promos, price, and stockouts move the KPI; if the MMM ignores them, paid channels get credit or blame they do not deserve. ETL writes a date-level control matrix from CSV or in-memory frames, not a live API. Quincena is day 15 or the last calendar day. Do not sum controls across channels. baseline_sales stays on the spend panel. Brand search can be a mediator. Inventory can be a result of demand. Controls are aligned for later conditioning and are not in the Meridian fit. Month-end quincena and the synthetic holiday list are decided, not gaps.

nodes.label: Dockerfile
nodes.rationale: Micromamba image using environment.yml for the dashboard and allocator on port 8501. Full Meridian MCMC is a conda/CPU job. The first image build is heavy. COPY . can include paths .dockerignore does not exclude.

nodes.label: .dockerignore
nodes.rationale: Excludes Secret/, .git, .env, __pycache__, and .conda. Does not list .pytest_cache or .cursor. That omission is GAP-402-DOCKERIGNORE.

nodes.label: src.data.etl
nodes.rationale: STORY-103 spend panel. STORY-501 main also writes date-level exogenous controls. python -m src.data.etl writes clean_spend.parquet and exogenous_controls.parquet.

nodes.label: src.models.meridian_data
nodes.rationale: STORY-201 adapter from post-QA clean parquet to Meridian national InputData. KPI is baseline_sales via groupby(date).first() then week sum. Media is impressions. Spend is the ROI denominator. revenue_per_kpi is 1.0 so iROAS is units per dollar. Default freq W, week ending Sunday. Reads clean_spend.parquet only.

nodes.label: clean_spend.parquet
nodes.rationale: Date by channel spend panel after Pandera validation. Missing spend, impressions, and clicks are zero-filled (pause or absent export). Missing baseline_sales is forward-filled. Media QA may overwrite it. Meridian trains on this panel only. baseline_sales is the site-wide daily unit KPI repeated on each channel row; do not sum it across channels.

nodes.label: Path-C synthetic panel
nodes.rationale: Synthetic multi-channel panel for portfolio and recovery tests. Generator seed 42 writes 728 days by 4 channels (meta, google, tiktok, tv). The DGP calls geometric_adstock and hill_saturation. KPI is integer baseline_sales units, not revenue. Committed CSV is locked after integer post-processing. Channel-level only; campaign grain and multiple KPIs are out of scope for STORY-101.

nodes.label: STORY-104 media QA gate
nodes.rationale: After ETL, impressions and clicks are checked against each channel's recent history. Repair when history exists. Hard-fail with exit not zero if anomalies remain unrepaired so Meridian never trains on bad media. Never mutates spend or baseline_sales. Rules: 14-day trailing window and at least 7 prior spend-positive days to repair.

nodes.label: google-meridian
nodes.rationale: Local pip library, not a Google Cloud API, and it needs no API key. environment.yml pins google-meridian==2.1.0. Tested with arviz 0.19.x, matplotlib 3.10.x, and pymc 6.x. matplotlib stays below 3.11 because arviz 0.19 breaks on the 3.11 style.core removal. MCMC runs on CPU via TensorFlow and TFP. The fit uses the post-QA spend panel only. Controls are not in the fit. Full MCMC stays a conda/CPU job; the Docker image is for the dashboard and allocator.

nodes.label: STORY-201 Meridian spike
nodes.rationale: National weekly Path-C spike is done. Do not treat it as recovered channel order. Meridian iROAS rank is meta, tiktok, tv, google. Path-C contribution and media_beta rank is tv, google, meta, tiktok. Spearman about -0.6. dod.directional_recovery false is status only and does not exit non-zero. Likely axes: media scaling (impressions versus media_beta times adstock times Hill), ROI priors, weekly aggregation, and iROAS not being the same object as contribution or media_beta. Registry id GAP-201-RANK.

nodes.label: exogenous_controls.parquet
nodes.rationale: One row per date, written by python -m src.data.etl beside clean_spend.parquet. Columns: organic_seo_clicks, brand_search_volume, crm_email_volume, holiday_flag, quincena_flag, price_drop_flag, inventory_oos_flag. A missing auxiliary day is zero-filled. brand_search_volume can be a mediator. inventory_oos_flag can be a result of demand. Not in the Meridian fit. Do not sum control columns across channels.

nodes.label: STORY-102 adstock and Hill transforms
nodes.rationale: geometric adstock, Weibull adstock, and Hill saturation live in src/models/transformations.py. The Path-C DGP imports those helpers so there is one source of truth. Validation is a Plotly Express script, not a Jupyter notebook. A perf gate requires geometric_adstock, weibull_adstock, and hill_saturation under 1 second on about 730 days by 4 channels.

nodes.label: pathc models parameter recovery note
nodes.rationale: Directional check only. Meridian ROI and Hill parameterization is not Path-C media_beta times geometric adstock times Hill saturation. Compare ranks, not point estimates. Not a hard fail. Meridian iROAS rank meta, tiktok, tv, google versus Path-C contribution rank tv, google, meta, tiktok. Spearman -0.600. Verdict: directional mismatch; investigate media scaling and priors.

nodes.label: DATA_CARD
nodes.rationale: Raw panel grain, KPI rules, ETL fill rules, client-wall paths, geo-experiment prior, STORY-104 QA gate, and Meridian weekly aggregation.

nodes.label: reports parameter recovery note
nodes.rationale: Same directional STORY-201 recovery note as the pathc models copy. recovery_spearman and dod.directional_recovery in metrics.json are status only. Spearman -0.600. The spike script does not hard-fail on the mismatch.

nodes.label: Plotly scripts, not notebooks

nodes.label: src.models.calibration
nodes.rationale: STORY-503 geo-experiment ROI prior. roi_m only. No posterior. python -m src.models.calibration writes reports/calibration_delta.json.

nodes.label: geo_experiment.json
nodes.rationale: data/raw/calibration/geo_experiment.json holds synthetic national ROI bounds for meta and google, plus one bogota row that the national prior ignores. These numbers are not Path-C ground truth.

nodes.label: STORY-503 MMT Geo-Experiment Calibration Gate
nodes.rationale: Top-down MMM should be checked against bottom-up geo lift so platform attribution windows do not warp channel strength. National roi bounds become a log-normal roi_m prior. A bogota row is ignored. There is no posterior sample and no city model. The checked-in JSON is synthetic, not a live MMT feed and not Path-C ground truth. scripts/02_model_spike.py --calibration calls build_report before sample_prior. A channel fails when its central interval misses the experiment bounds or its scale is not tighter than the default prior. The process exits 1 and does not build Meridian. Omitting --calibration keeps PriorDistribution(). Original DoD asked for live experiment results and regional drift; that part is not in this code. GAP-201-RANK stays open.

nodes.label: calibration_delta.json
nodes.rationale: Before/after calibration report. For pathc, python -m src.models.calibration writes reports/calibration_delta.json. Wellness has no experiment file, so its report leaves every channel on the default prior.

nodes.label: PriorDistribution
nodes.rationale: Default Meridian prior kept when the spike is run without --calibration.

nodes.label: roi_m prior
nodes.rationale: Log-normal national media ROI prior built from geo-experiment roi bounds. A bogota row does not move it. The calibration command does not sample a posterior. The spike accepts it only when each calibrated channel's central interval stays inside the experiment bounds and its scale is tighter than the default prior.

nodes.label: sample_prior
nodes.rationale: Meridian sampling step. The calibration gate must pass before it. A failing gate exits 1 and does not reach sample_prior, and Meridian is not built.

nodes.label: graphify and archify artifact index
nodes.rationale: Index of the knowledge graph and the Sprint 3 architecture diagram. Pipeline stated there: Path-C panel, client wall default pathc, ETL spend panel and date-level exogenous_controls.parquet, media QA, Meridian on the spend panel only. Optional --calibration must pass the ROI-prior gate before sample_prior; a miss exits 1 and does not sample. Then response curves, SLSQP, fact pack and number lock, offline or Claude brief, and Streamlit. The client wall is the industry separation, not a second model. Controls are not in the fit.

nodes.label: STORY-301 SLSQP allocator
nodes.rationale: Constrained budget optimizer on offline response curves via scipy.optimize SLSQP. Reads Meridian response_curves.means or a synthetic fixture. On solver failure channels is an empty object so callers do not read a partial plan. Allocations follow those curves even though Meridian rank recovery versus Path-C is open, so they are not Path-C ground truth. Numbers are incremental KPI, not revenue.

nodes.label: STORY-302 C-suite brief
nodes.rationale: Fact pack, schema, and brief. --offline fills the brief from allocation JSON. Live mode calls Anthropic claude-sonnet-4-5 and forces emit_brief. Structured spend, delta, KPI, and saturation flags stay exact. Headline and bullets may round a fact (lift 0.12) and must say incremental KPI, not dollars or revenue. Key is ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or gitignored Secret/anthropic_api_key.

nodes.label: STORY-401 Streamlit dashboard
nodes.rationale: Local dashboard. Total budget and each partner min and max percent are spend bounds. optimize_budget chooses the investment. Infeasible bounds show the allocator error and do not call Claude. Update insights is the only Claude call (render_live). Before that click, commentary is the offline brief. Changing a control clears the live brief. Math is src/dashboard/view.py. Layout is app/streamlit_app.py. Pass --client_id pathc.

nodes.label: How to test the dashboard
nodes.rationale: Click-through with no statistics background. Offline commentary stays until Update insights. A live Claude rewrite needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or Secret/anthropic_api_key and fails only that optional step. A good result is not currency, not client revenue, and not proof that Meridian channel rank matches the synthetic ground truth.

nodes.label: environment.yml
nodes.rationale: Supported conda install. Env name mmt-mmm, Python 3.12, conda-forge. matplotlib is pinned >=3.8,<3.11 because arviz 0.19, pulled by google-meridian, needs matplotlib.style.core and breaks on 3.11+. Pip pins google-meridian==2.1.0 for the STORY-201 spike, anthropic==1.13.0 for the STORY-302 live brief, and streamlit==1.65.0 for the STORY-401 dashboard. Change it only when code needs a package. Do not install into conda base.

nodes.label: requirements.txt
nodes.rationale: Direct dependencies only, not a transitive freeze. The supported install remains conda env mmt-mmm from environment.yml. Lists the same direct pins, including google-meridian==2.1.0, anthropic==1.13.0, streamlit==1.65.0, and matplotlib>=3.8,<3.11.

nodes.label: --client_id
nodes.rationale: Explicit tenant flag. Defaults to pathc. Used on ETL, QA, the Meridian spike, the allocator, the brief, calibration, and Streamlit. Omitting it still reads and writes today's Path-C files.

nodes.label: src.data.tenants
nodes.rationale: STORY-502 client filesystem wall. Raises TenantError when a path lands in another client. Fail-closed path check.

nodes.label: pathc
nodes.rationale: Default client. USD. Channels meta, google, tiktok, tv. Region national. raw data/raw, processed data/processed, models data/clients/pathc/models, reports reports.

nodes.label: wellness
nodes.rationale: Second client in the yaml. USD. Channels meta and google. Region national. Docs place it only under data/clients/wellness/. It has no experiment file, so calibration leaves every channel on the default prior.

nodes.label: STORY-502 Multi-Tenant Client Wall
nodes.rationale: One codebase, many clients, without mixing data, configs, or model runs. Industry separation is the filesystem wall, not a second model. Regions are labels. --client_id defaults to pathc. pathc keeps data/raw, data/processed, and reports; models are data/clients/pathc/models. wellness is only data/clients/wellness/ with raw, processed, models, and reports. src/data/tenants.py raises TenantError on a cross-client path. Original DoD asked for raw/processed/weights/reports; landed names are raw, processed, models, and reports.

nodes.label: config/clients.yaml
nodes.rationale: Client map for currency, channels, and regions. pathc declares filesystem paths. wellness declares currency, channels, and a national region label and does not declare raw, processed, models, or reports paths in this file.
